DML.SELECT: SELECT alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", filtered_until as "filteredUntil", alarm_disabled as "alarmDisabled", user_id as "userId", comment as "comment" FROM conf.alarms_filtered
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.alarms_filtered (alarm_config_id, element_type_id, element_id, filtered_until, alarm_disabled, user_id, comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:alarmConfigId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :filteredUntil, :alarmDisabled, :userId, :comment, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.alarms_filtered SET filtered_until = :filteredUntil, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.alarms_filtered WHERE alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
